Let all exponents below be in \(\mathbb F_2\). For fixed \(u,v\),

\[
(\mathcal F f_{\pi,g})(u,v)
=2^{-8}\sum_{y\in E}(-1)^{g(y)+y\cdot u}\sum_{x\in E}(-1)^{x\cdot(\pi(y)+v)}.
\]

The inner sum is \(2^8\) if \(\pi(y)=v\), and \(0\) otherwise. Hence, writing \(z=\pi^{-1}(v)\),

\[
(\mathcal F f_{\pi,g})(u,v)=(-1)^{g(z)+z\cdot u}.
\]

We need this to equal

\[
f_{\pi,g}(u,v)=(-1)^{u\cdot \pi(v)+g(v)}
\]

for all \(u,v\). Since the dot product is nondegenerate, this is equivalent to

\[
\pi^{-1}(v)=\pi(v)\quad\text{for all }v,
\]

and then also

\[
g(\pi^{-1}(v))=g(v).
\]

Thus \(\pi\) must be an affine involution, and \(g\) must be constant on the orbits of \(\pi\), with the orbit containing \(0\) forced to have value \(0\).

Write \(\pi(y)=My+c\), and put \(N=M+I\). Since the field has characteristic \(2\), the condition \(\pi^2=1\) becomes

\[
N^2=0,\qquad c\in \ker N.
\]

Let \(r=\operatorname{rank}N\). Then \(0\le r\le 4\). The number of square-zero maps \(N\) of rank \(r\) is

\[
A_r=\binom{8}{r}_2\binom{8-r}{r}_2|\operatorname{GL}(r,2)|,
\]

because we choose \(\operatorname{im}N=U\), then \(\ker N=K\supset U\), then an isomorphism \(E/K\to U\). These values are

\[
A_0=1,\quad A_1=32385,\quad A_2=42165270,\quad A_3=2529916200,\quad A_4=4047865920.
\]

For fixed \(N\), if \(c\in \operatorname{im}N\), then \(\pi\) has \(2^{8-r}\) fixed points, so it has

\[
128+2^{7-r}
\]

orbits. There are \(2^r\) such \(c\). If \(c\in\ker N\setminus \operatorname{im}N\), then \(\pi\) has no fixed points, so it has \(128\) orbits. There are \(2^{8-r}-2^r\) such \(c\).

Therefore the number of allowed \(g\)'s is \(2^{\#\text{orbits}-1}\), and the total count is

\[
\sum_{r=0}^4 A_r\left(2^r2^{127+2^{7-r}}+(2^{8-r}-2^r)2^{127}\right).
\]

Substituting the \(A_r\)'s and simplifying gives

\[
\boxed{2^{127}\cdot 340282366920939658259713998470149879141}.
\]
